comments.author: DIC
comments.body: Need help. I don't know how to create a new entry for ivyro, I wanted to make a quest guide for "Delivery Request for the capital of Russia". I end up using another quest as template. Please help :)

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
To the best of my knowledge, only the UWO DB site maintainers/admins can create entirely new quest pages for us to later add information to; the fact that this has not yet been done to add quest pages for all the new Gran Atlas content has been a bit of a problem to say the least, and is why most of the information we players have gathered in the mean time is either stored in various articles on ivyro (with Russia as an example) or on the OGP Forum's UWO Guide section.

In the mean time, you could try saving the information you've gathered to a notepad, and keep it handy for a future ivyro page addition, if you like. I've reverted this quest page to its correct information for the sake of players who might need this quest's guide in the the mean time, but your "Delivery Request for the Capital of Russia" template can be accessed by clicking on it at any time up where it shows your username and edited quest info.

As a side note to any mods/admins: this quest is actually named "The one I can't forget".
